{{ElectionsOH}}
The '''2026 Ohio state auditor election''' took place on November 3, 2026, to elect the [[State Auditor of Ohio|state auditor of Ohio]]. Incumbent [[Republican Party of Ohio|Republican]] [[Keith Faber]] was term-limited and ineligible to run for re-election. He was [[2026 Ohio Attorney General election|running]] for [[Ohio Attorney General|attorney general of Ohio]]. Primary elections were held on May 5.

[[Frank LaRose]], the incumbent [[Ohio Secretary of State]], narrowly defeated [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] nominee Annette Blackwell. This was the only statewide office won by a Republican in Ohio in the [[2026 Ohio elections|2026 elections]].

== Libertarian primary ==
Jeffery did not advance to the general election, after failing to receive the minimum 500 votes in the primary.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Section 3513.23 - Ohio Revised Code {{!}} Ohio Laws |url=https://codes.ohio.gov/ohio-revised-code/section-3513.23 |access-date=2026-05-02 |website=codes.ohio.gov}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Section 3513.05 - Ohio Revised Code {{!}} Ohio Laws |url=https://codes.ohio.gov/ohio-revised-code/section-3513.05 |access-date=2026-05-02 |website=codes.ohio.gov}}</ref>
